gloss: number of votes received; vote tally

definitions.gloss: number of votes received; vote tally
definitions.explanation: The count of votes that a specific candidate, party, or option has received in an election or poll.

examples.japanese: {得票数|とくひょうすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The candidate with the highest number of votes wins.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前回|ぜんかい}→前回：11817_zenkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧{得票数|とくひょうすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of votes received increased significantly compared to the previous election.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{得票数|とくひょうすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{選挙管理委員会|せんきょかんりいいんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ウェブサイト→ウェブサイト：05152_webusaito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}できる→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: The vote tally for each candidate can be checked on the election commission's website.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{得票|とくひょう}→得票：19111_tokuhyou⟧ (receiving votes) and ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number). Specifically refers to the number of votes a particular candidate or option has garnered, as opposed to the total votes cast.

This is a standard term in election reporting and political analysis. It appears frequently in news coverage of elections at all levels.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {得票数|とくひょうすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: to have a high vote count
- {得票数|とくひょうすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧: vote count increases
- {得票数|とくひょうすう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{上回|うわまわ}る→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧: to surpass in vote count
- ⟦{最多|さいた}→最多：28216_saita⟧⟦{得票|とくひょう}→得票：19111_tokuhyou⟧: most votes received

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{票数|ひょうすう}→票数：25137_hyousuu⟧: number of votes — the total vote count, not specific to one candidate
- {得票率|とくひょうりつ}: percentage of votes received — the proportion rather than the raw count
- ⟦{投票数|とうひょうすう}→投票数：26674_touhyousuu⟧: number of ballots cast — focuses on total participation
